scenicChapters.title: Kenya Great Rift Valley Escarpment Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 26 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: Enns - Gräberstraße → Wallsee - Kastell
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 27 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-schlogen-vicus-wallsee-kastell-2.story: A 187 km round trip from Waldkirchen am Wesen - roughly 3 h 13 in the saddle. The stops in between: Hirschleitengraben - Wachtturm, Enns - Gräberstraße, Wallsee - Kastell and back through Enns - Gräberstraße. The line favours views over speed.

legend-dades-gorge-road.slogan: Dades Gorge Road – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-dades-gorge-road.story: A canyon road from Boumalne Dades, Morocco to Msemrir, Morocco, via Ait Oudinar. Key character: red canyon; hairpins; kasbah villages. Surface: paved.

scenicChapters.title: Dades Gorge Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 18 km this is Dades Gorge Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
